helpful: Provisioned full-text petition and BIO: the BIO's vehicle arguments (facial-only challenge, reliance on Hadley) were the single most useful input.
CourtListener read_document for the short CA7 opinion confirmed the decision below rests on Hadley.
Statpack salience-band table with the bracketed reached rate gave a clean anchor.
gaps: CourtListener holds SCOTUS dockets for the companion petitions but no docket entries; I had to fetch supremecourt.gov docket pages over the web to learn they share this case's conference.

A structured way to find same-conference or same-issue companion petitions (e.g. dockets distributed for the same conference, or dockets whose lower-court opinion cites the same precedent) would have saved most of the retrieval budget.
fedcourts query has no text or issue filter for SCOTUS rows, so it could not surface takings / forfeiture priors; the era query returned only recency-ranked unrelated denials.
notes: About 15 retrieval calls, under the advisory budget. Corpus query ran once for its transfer line and shape; the substantive prior work came from the statpack and the companion dockets.
